title: Restfulness and Least Action: A Category-Theoretic Comparison
description: Whether restfulness (vishram) in Madhyasth Darshan structurally mirrors the Principle of Least Action — mapped through category-theoretic functors, forgetful reduction, and colimits.

title: Coexistence from First Principles
description: The complete formal statement of Madhyasth Darshan: a three-primitive kernel - satta, triadic activity, and saturation - generating the tier-neutral template of units, relationships, values, composition, and transmission, with a clause-level recovery audit and a category-theoretic formalisation that shows where the notation stops
